_comment: Declared open-keyed maps for the schema INFERENCE (map-ness is a schema fact, never inferred from instance key counts). `path` may contain '*' segments (each matches exactly one map key) so maps nested inside map items are declarable — a new bridge token or reward coin must extend the DATA, not the schema. Top-level `symbols` and `packages` are absent on purpose: their schemas are hand-written in scripts/gen_schema.py (TOP), which is the sole source of their map-ness. base:'symbols' maps are checked ⊆ the symbol universe by check-consistency.mjs ('*' paths included — it expands them with the same semantics); base:'open' maps are unconstrained keyspaces. This _comment convention is for the three tool-owned schema/*.json files only — a _comment in the served DATA fails the generator (audit P5).
